main_text.p: cum ingenio sibi auctore dignitatem reperissent, perfecisse ut in respondendo Iure, auctoritate plus etiam quàm ipso ingenio ualerent, sic infert: Senectuti uero celebrandæ & ornandæ quod« honestius potest esse refugium, quàm Iuris interpretatio? Equidem mihi hoc subsidium iam inde ab adolescentia comparaui, non solum ad causarum usum forensem, sed« etiam ad decus atque ornamentum senectutis: ut cum« me uires, quod ferè iam tempus aduentat, deficere coepissent, ista ab solitudine domum meam uindicarem. Quid est« enim

page.notes: The right-margin « marks are printed quotation marks running down the margin beside the quoted passage; they are recorded as notes at each line end, where they stand. Line-end «: after "ornandæ quod", "refu-", "interpre-", "subfi-", "adolescen-", "ad", "sed", "orna-", "cum", "tem", "coepif", "domu", "est". Apostrophe in "ab'folitudine" is a printer's mark and is read here as a space. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Lines that break within a word without a printed hyphen (e.g. "Iu/re", "tem/pus", "coepif/fent") are joined. The left margin shows only the gutter and no printed text.
